title: TOWN OF SUTTON | MASSACHUSETTS
description: The official website of Sutton, Massachusetts, serves as a comprehensive digital hub for the town’s community. It provides residents and visitors with easy access to essential municipal services and up‑to‑date information. Users can explore various departments, view meeting agendas and minutes, and watch recordings of public sessions. The site also facilitates practical tasks such as paying bills online, applying for permits, and checking property details via GIS maps. In addition, the portal highlights local initiatives — for example, the Sutton Power Choice program focused on clean energy — and connects people to key community resources, including the public schools, library, and senior center. Visitors can stay informed through news updates and the event calendar, while those interested in contributing to the town can browse volunteer and employment opportunities. Overall, the website strengthens civic engagement and streamlines interaction with local government.
